review_basis:
A genuinely fresh real project (Spokane Transit Authority cooling tower replacement), pulled from the original corpus GitHub Release during a ninth batch-survey pass (also covering 16_NV_CarsonValleyMS, 19_CA_VistaUSD, 20_TX_JudsonISD, 24_IA_JohnsonCounty -- Carson Valley MS's own M3.01 sheet had 35 real large OA/EA duct callouts but every candidate that returned a size either failed the bench-seed check or refused outright, not pursued). Screened for image coverage first per Run 86's own established check: `imgRatio` reads 0.00 on this sheet, real vector CAD.

This sheet is a dense pump-room piping schematic with abundant real `6" HWS`/`5" HWS` callouts. A grid sweep of nine of them found a real, clean 1.67 LF straight `6" HWS` (heating hot water supply) pipe segment: `size:{kind:pipe,nps_in:6}`, `systems:["HWS"]`, confidence 0. A marked crop confirms it visually: a real short pipe segment sitting directly at this project's own EXISTING/NEW construction-phase demarcation marker (a vertical dashed boundary line with 'EXISTING'/'NEW' callouts, a standard renovation-drawing convention), bounded by that boundary marker on one end (`backward: branch_joins_main`) and a real flexible-connector/union fitting on the other (`forward: ambiguous`). Verified using the exact `bench:linear` seeding convention BEFORE authoring (standard practice since Run 95): the bench-style seed reproduces the identical trace exactly. `resolveRunSegments` also reproduces the identical single segment.

Honest disclosure: this pump room has MANY closely-spaced `6" HWS` labels along what is largely one continuous real pipeline as it winds through several inline fittings, unions, and dampers -- visually dense, though not a crosstalk risk in the same sense as this session's other declined twin-pipe cases, since every nearby label reads the identical `6" HWS` size/system, so which specific text instance the automatic bind actually used cannot affect the recorded size or system either way. A separate, less-clean `6" HWS` candidate on this same sheet (5.5 LF from an ad hoc seed) was tested and found to FAIL the bench-seed check (no size bind from the 40%-along point) and was not authored.
scope: A single real 6-inch heating-hot-water-supply (HWS) pipe segment (1.67 LF) on the Spokane Transit cooling tower project's own pump room piping schematic, sheet M-201, from this project's own EXISTING/NEW construction-phase boundary marker to a real flexible-connector/union fitting. Explicitly OUT OF SCOPE: the pipe's own continuation past either boundary (into the existing piping on one side, through the union fitting on the other); the declined 5.5 LF `6" HWS` candidate on this same sheet that failed the bench-seed check, not authored; the several other closely-spaced `6"`/`5" HWS` labels along the same visible run, not independently attempted; every other sheet on this real 14-sheet plan set.
